cd /tmp/obench-cell-7qagnzzr/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_biflv4ks; mkdir -p /tmp/pptest; cat > /tmp/pptest/t.py <<'EOF'
import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.nn.functional as F
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
dist.init_process_group("gloo")
r, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
torch.manual_seed(0)
cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float()
m = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float(); m.load_state_dict(ref.state_dict())
ids = torch.randint(0,100,(4,8)); tg = torch.randint(0,100,(4,8))
inp, tgt = list(ids.chunk(2)), list(tg.chunk(2))
loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(m, inp, tgt, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
rl = 0
for a,b in zip(inp,tgt):
    l = F.cross_entropy(ref(a).logits.reshape(-1,100), b.reshape(-1))/2; l.backward(); rl += l.item()
maxd = 0
for (n,p),(_,q) in zip(m.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
    if p.grad is not None: maxd = max(maxd, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
print(r, "loss", loss, rl, "maxgraddiff", maxd, "n grads", sum(p.grad is not None for p in m.parameters()))
dist.destroy_process_group()
EOF
for n in 1 2; do torchrun --nproc_per_node=$n /tmp/pptest/t.py 2>&1 | grep -v Warn | tail -3; done
